title.en: Pi Web Search: Keyless, API & Self-Hosted Options
title.zh: Pi 网页搜索选型：免 Key、商业 API 与自托管

description.en: Compare Pi web search and fetching: Exa MCP, explicit DuckDuckGo, Brave, Tavily, Exa APIs, SearXNG and Ollama endpoints.
description.zh: 比较 Pi 网络搜索与抓取：Exa MCP、显式 DuckDuckGo、Brave/Tavily/Exa API、SearXNG 和 Ollama 端点。

en: Searching discovers URLs; fetching reads a URL you already know. A keyless HTTP fetch is useful for public documentation, but does not replace a search engine or a browser for JavaScript-heavy pages.

Start with pi-web-access for keyless Exa MCP search and multi-format extraction. Use rpiv-web-tools for explicit backend selection, or @ollama/pi-web-search when its fixed local endpoint matches your existing Ollama setup.
zh: 搜索用于发现网址，抓取用于读取已知网址。免 Key 的 HTTP 抓取适合公开文档，但不能替代搜索引擎，也不能保证读取依赖 JavaScript 的页面。
希望免 Key 使用 Exa MCP 并提取多种格式，可从 pi-web-access 开始；希望明确选择后端，可用 rpiv-web-tools；已有匹配本地 Ollama 端点时，再考虑 @ollama/pi-web-search。

title.zh: 免 Key 路径与降级边界

en: pi-web-access uses Exa MCP without an API key. A configured SearXNG endpoint precedes it; the active Codex model can prioritize authenticated OpenAI search. DuckDuckGo HTML search requires provider: "duckduckgo" and is excluded from automatic selection and provider: "all".

Direct URL extraction starts with local HTTP/HTML processing. Remote hosted page extractors require an explicit opt-in. Search fallback and page-extraction fallback are separate mechanisms; a blocked page is not solved merely by switching the search engine.
zh: pi-web-access 可通过 Exa MCP 免 Key 搜索。配置过的 SearXNG 优先；当前模型为 Codex 时可优先使用已授权的 OpenAI 搜索。DuckDuckGo HTML 搜索需指定 provider: "duckduckgo"，不参加自动选择和 provider: "all"。
已知网址先经过本地 HTTP/HTML 提取；远程托管网页提取器需显式开启。搜索降级与正文提取降级是两套机制，换搜索引擎不一定能读取被拦截的网页。

en: With rpiv-web-tools, Brave uses BRAVE_SEARCH_API_KEY and direct HTTP page fetching; Tavily uses TAVILY_API_KEY and its extraction service; Exa uses EXA_API_KEY and its own content extraction. These are credentialed API routes, unlike pi-web-access’s keyless Exa MCP route.

Run /web-tools to select a backend. Missing credentials are an error, not an automatic switch. For predictable provider selection, verify /web-tools --show before comparing results. Quotas and charges belong to each provider account.
zh: rpiv-web-tools 中，Brave 使用 BRAVE_SEARCH_API_KEY，网页读取走直接 HTTP；Tavily 使用 TAVILY_API_KEY 及其提取服务；Exa 使用 EXA_API_KEY 及其正文接口。这些是有凭据的 API 路径，和 pi-web-access 的免 Key Exa MCP 不同。
运行 /web-tools 选择后端。缺少凭据会报错，不会自动切换。比较结果前，用 /web-tools --show 确认生效配置；额度与费用由各供应商账号决定。

en: rpiv-web-tools accepts SEARXNG_URL and OLLAMA_HOST. SearXNG needs JSON search enabled; it is a metasearch server that can still query public engines. Ollama local and cloud web-search endpoints have different paths, and a local daemon may still require sign-in or upstream access.

Neither package makes the public web available offline. The published @ollama/pi-web-search 0.0.5 source fixes the URL to localhost:11434 and registers web_search/web_fetch, despite different names and OLLAMA_HOST guidance in its README. Treat the published code as the compatibility boundary.
zh: rpiv-web-tools 接受 SEARXNG_URL、OLLAMA_HOST。SearXNG 须启用 JSON 搜索；它是元搜索服务，仍可能查询公共引擎。Ollama 的本地和云端网络搜索路径不同，本地守护进程也可能需要登录或访问上游。
这些包不会让公共互联网离线可用。@ollama/pi-web-search 0.0.5 发布源码固定访问 localhost:11434，并注册 web_search/web_fetch，与 README 的工具名及 OLLAMA_HOST 描述不同；应以发布源码判断兼容边界。

en: Install one web extension at a time because these packages can register overlapping tool names. In Pi, ask it to run the calls below, inspect the returned provider and source URLs, then fetch one result.

This checks routing and extraction independently. It does not prove search completeness or factual accuracy. The examples are usage recipes; this guide reviewed source and docs without making billed provider calls.
The calls below are specific to pi-web-access. rpiv and Ollama use their own web_search/web_fetch interfaces and do not accept this DuckDuckGo provider option.
zh: 建议一次启用一个网页扩展，这些包可能注册同名工具。在 Pi 中要求执行下面的调用，检查返回的供应商和来源链接，再读取一条结果。
这样能分别确认路由与正文提取，不代表搜索完整或答案准确。示例是验证方法；本指南核对源码与文档，未执行付费供应商调用。
下方调用仅适用于 pi-web-access。rpiv 与 Ollama 使用各自的 web_search/web_fetch 接口，不接受这里的 DuckDuckGo provider 参数。

sections.code:
web_search({ query: "Pi coding agent extension documentation", provider: "duckduckgo", numResults: 3 })
fetch_content({ url: "https://pi.dev/" })

summary.en: Search, page extraction, PDF reading and video analysis through one extension.
summary.zh: 在同一扩展中搜索网页、提取正文、读取 PDF 和分析视频。

mechanism.en: Registers native Pi tools. Search routes to provider APIs or Exa MCP; ordinary URLs start with direct HTTP and local HTML extraction, with configured extraction fallbacks. GitHub repository URLs have a local clone path.
mechanism.zh: 注册 Pi 原生工具。搜索通过供应商 API 或 Exa MCP；普通网址先走直接 HTTP 与本地 HTML 提取，再按配置降级。GitHub 仓库网址另有本地克隆路径。

prerequisites.en: Pi and outbound network access. Exa MCP needs no API key; keyed providers need their own credentials. GitHub cloning needs Git. PDF text extraction uses bundled unpdf/pdf.js; ffmpeg and yt-dlp are optional for video frames.
prerequisites.zh: 需要 Pi 和可访问外网的网络。Exa MCP 免 Key，其他 API 需对应凭据。GitHub 克隆需要 Git；PDF 本地文字提取使用包内 unpdf/pdf.js；视频抽帧可选安装 ffmpeg 和 yt-dlp。

limitations.en: Keyless does not mean offline or unlimited. DuckDuckGo is explicit-only. The local PDF fallback has no OCR. Private or age-restricted YouTube videos can fail, and readable content behind a paywall is not guaranteed.
limitations.zh: 免 Key 不代表离线或无限额度。DuckDuckGo 需显式选择；PDF 本地兜底没有 OCR；私密或年龄受限的 YouTube 视频可能失败，也不保证获取付费墙后的正文。

dataSent.en: Queries go to the chosen search service. Hosted extraction receives URLs; configured Datalab/Gemini PDF processing receives PDF bytes. Local video analysis may upload video to Gemini. Browser-cookie access is opt-in.
dataSent.zh: 查询发送给选中的搜索服务。托管提取服务接收网址；配置 Datalab/Gemini 的 PDF 处理会发送 PDF 文件内容；本地视频分析可能上传视频到 Gemini。浏览器 Cookie 读取需显式启用。

failure.en: Automatic search tries eligible fallbacks; a named provider is strict. Exhausted routes return diagnostics. Remote hosted HTTP extraction is disabled unless fetchRouting.allowRemoteHostedProviders is enabled.
failure.zh: 自动搜索尝试可用降级来源；指定供应商时严格使用该来源。来源耗尽返回诊断。远程托管 HTTP 提取须启用 fetchRouting.allowRemoteHostedProviders。

summary.en: Choose a single search backend, including commercial APIs and self-hosted endpoints.
summary.zh: 在商业搜索 API 和自托管服务端点之间选择一个搜索后端。

mechanism.en: Registers web_search and web_fetch. A per-call provider overrides the environment, then config, then the Brave default. Fetching uses provider extraction where available, otherwise direct HTTP-to-text.
mechanism.zh: 注册 web_search 与 web_fetch。单次调用指定的 provider 优先于环境变量、配置文件及默认 Brave。抓取优先使用供应商提取接口，否则直接 HTTP 转文本。

prerequisites.en: Node.js ≥ 22 and Pi. Brave, Tavily and Exa require keys. SearXNG requires a reachable instance with JSON output enabled. Ollama requires working web-search endpoints; local and cloud endpoint paths differ.
prerequisites.zh: 需要 Node.js ≥ 22 和 Pi。Brave、Tavily、Exa 需要 Key；SearXNG 需要可达且启用 JSON 输出的实例；Ollama 需要可用的网络搜索端点，本地与云端路径不同。

limitations.en: No cross-provider fallback. Plain HTTP fetch does not render arbitrary JavaScript. Self-hosted endpoints do not establish offline operation or prove that the upstream search service stays within your network.
limitations.zh: 没有跨供应商自动降级。普通 HTTP 抓取不会执行任意 JavaScript。自托管入口不代表离线运行，也不证明上游搜索不会离开本地网络。

dataSent.en: The chosen service receives search queries and provider-extracted URLs. Direct HTTP fetch contacts the target site. SearXNG may forward queries to its configured engines.
dataSent.zh: 选中的服务接收搜索查询与需要提取的网址；直接 HTTP 抓取访问目标网站。SearXNG 还可能将查询转发到配置的搜索引擎。

failure.en: Missing commercial credentials throw an actionable error instead of selecting another service. SearXNG 403 can indicate disabled JSON output; connection errors expose an unavailable local Ollama service.
failure.zh: 缺少商业服务凭据会报错提示配置，不会改用其他服务。SearXNG 403 可能表示 JSON 输出关闭；连接错误可能表示本地 Ollama 未启动。

summary.en: A small adapter for an already running local Ollama web-search service.
summary.zh: 为已运行的本地 Ollama 网络搜索服务提供轻量接入。

mechanism.en: The published 0.0.5 code registers web_search and web_fetch and posts to localhost:11434/api/experimental/web_search and /web_fetch. It does not load a local language model itself.
mechanism.zh: 0.0.5 发布源码注册 web_search、web_fetch，POST 到 localhost:11434/api/experimental/web_search 与 /web_fetch；扩展本身不加载本地语言模型。

prerequisites.en: Pi plus a running Ollama service exposing those experimental APIs. A 401 response asks the user to run ollama signin; the extension has no API-key configuration field.
prerequisites.zh: 需要 Pi 及提供这些实验 API 的 Ollama 服务。401 响应提示运行 ollama signin；扩展没有 API Key 配置字段。

limitations.en: The npm source hardcodes localhost:11434 despite README advice about OLLAMA_HOST, and actual tool names differ from the README. Endpoint compatibility depends on Ollama. A local endpoint is not a guarantee of offline or local-only search.
limitations.zh: npm 源码将地址固定为 localhost:11434，虽然 README 提到 OLLAMA_HOST；实际工具名也与 README 不同。端点兼容性取决于 Ollama。本地入口不保证离线或只在本地搜索。

dataSent.en: Search queries and fetch URLs go to the local Ollama daemon. The extension does not control the daemon’s upstream routing.
dataSent.zh: 查询与抓取网址发送给本地 Ollama 守护进程；扩展不控制守护进程的上游路由。

failure.en: API and connection errors are returned to Pi; there is no alternative provider fallback.
failure.zh: API 与连接错误返回给 Pi；没有备用供应商降级。
